masteryZone.q: Which is the oldest Central University in UP?
masteryZone.sol: University of Allahabad is the oldest central university, founded in 1887.

masteryZone.q: In which year was BHU established?
masteryZone.sol: BHU was established in 1916 by Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University is located in Raebareli.
masteryZone.sol: False. It is located at Fursatganj in Amethi district.

masteryZone.q: What is the historical nickname of Allahabad University?
Where is the Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) located?
Where is the Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) located?
masteryZone.sol: IIVR is located in Shahanshahpur, Varanasi.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The National Sugar Institute is located in Lucknow.
masteryZone.sol: False. The National Sugar Institute is in Kanpur; the Sugarcane Research Institute is in Lucknow.

masteryZone.q: Where is the Central Institute for Research on Goats (CIRG) located?
Where is the Indian Grassland and Fodder Research Institute (IGFRI) located?
Where is the Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI) located?
masteryZone.sol: IVRI is located in Izatnagar, Bareilly.

masteryZone.q: True or False: King George's Medical University is located in Kanpur.
masteryZone.sol: False. KGMU is located in Lucknow.
